Why do we know so much about personal growth, yet struggle to live it consistently?

 Today, we’ve sold over  4 million products globally  and reached millions of people around the world. But we are still early in our journey. We are building something that can scale meaningfully without losing its soul.
 This role matters because marketing at Intelligent Change is not about noise or growth at any cost. It is about turning purpose into presence, and presence into sustainable scale.
 If you are excited by the idea of building a world-class brand rooted in intention, ritual, and real impact, this role is for you.
 — Alex Ikonn 
Founder, Intelligent Change
 About Intelligent Change 
 Intelligent Change exists to help people design better lives through small, consistent rituals that compound over time.
 We create physical tools and experiences that turn personal growth into something people can actually live. Not through pressure or motivation, but through structure, reflection, and intention.

We are entering a pivotal phase of growth and are looking for a senior marketing leader who can help us scale with focus, taste, and discipline, while preserving the heart of what makes this brand matter.

 The  Director of Marketing & Growth  will own how Intelligent Change shows up in the world and how it grows.
 This is a senior, hands-on leadership role at the intersection of  brand, content, performance, and commerce . You will be responsible for building a modern marketing engine that drives awareness, revenue, and long-term brand equity.

 As Product Owner for Sadie, you will be responsible for turning our product vision and roadmap into clearly defined, deliverable product outcomes.
 You will work closely with management, customers, engineering, design, and commercial teams to understand what needs to be built, define how it should work, and ensure it is delivered successfully.
 A major part of your role will be translating product ideas and customer problems into clear requirements, workflows, tickets, acceptance criteria, and expected behaviours that engineering can execute against.

 Tester Sadie dans des scénarios réels afin de s’assurer que les fonctionnalités et les comportements fonctionnent comme prévu.
 Analyser de véritables appels clients, la rétroaction reçue et l’utilisation du produit afin de cerner les lacunes, les cas limites et les occasions d’amélioration.
 Travailler avec les clients et les équipes internes pour comprendre les problèmes et traduire la rétroaction en exigences produit concrètes.
 Coordonner les projets pilotes et les mises en production, y compris la définition de la portée, des comportements attendus, des critères de succès et des boucles de rétroaction.
 Cerner les dépendances, les blocages, les risques et les exigences manquantes avant qu’ils n’affectent la livraison.
 Maintenir une documentation claire sur les fonctionnalités du produit, les décisions prises, les exigences et les comportements attendus.
 Suivre l’avancement par rapport à la roadmap et communiquer l’état du produit, les blocages et les changements aux parties prenantes concernées.
 Veiller à ce que les fonctionnalités ne soient pas simplement livrées, mais qu’elles réalisent réellement la vision produit initiale et résolvent le problème client visé.
 Améliorer continuellement la façon dont les exigences sont définies, communiquées, testées et livrées au sein de l’organisation produit.

 Au moins 2 ans d’expérience à titre de Product Owner, analyste d’affaires ou dans un rôle similaire axé sur le produit.
 Expérience de travail en étroite collaboration avec des équipes de génie logiciel pour livrer des produits destinés aux clients.
 Grande capacité à transformer une idée produit de haut niveau en exigences détaillées et concrètes.
 Expérience de la rédaction de tickets produit, de user stories, de critères d’acceptation et d’exigences fonctionnelles clairs.
 Bonne compréhension des workflows produit, des parcours utilisateurs, des cas limites et des comportements système attendus.
 Expérience de la gestion et de la priorisation d’un backlog produit.
 Grand souci du détail et capacité à repérer les lacunes ou les ambiguïtés avant le début du développement.
 Capacité à comprendre suffisamment les concepts techniques pour communiquer efficacement avec les équipes d’ingénierie.
 Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes et capacité à prendre des décisions pragmatiques lorsque les exigences ou les priorités changent.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et verbale.
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs initiatives et priorités dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
 Fort sens de la prise en charge et de l’imputabilité quant à la qualité du produit final, et non seulement quant à la fermeture des tickets.
 Atouts 
 Expérience avec des produits conversationnels, vocaux, de communication ou de workflow.
 Expérience auprès d’entreprises du secteur de l’hôtellerie, de la restauration ou d’autres entreprises de services.
 Expérience de la gestion de produits complexes comportant de multiples intégrations et dépendances.
 Expérience au sein d’une entreprise en démarrage (startup) ou dans un environnement produit en évolution rapide.
 À l’aise dans un environnement où la roadmap évolue rapidement en fonction des besoins des clients et de l’entreprise.
 Ce poste est-il fait pour moi ?

 Vous devriez naturellement vous poser des questions comme :
 Que doit-il se passer exactement ? Que se passe-t-il si quelque chose ne fonctionne pas ? Quels sont les cas limites ? À quoi ressemble le succès ? Ce que nous avons construit correspond-il réellement à ce que nous avions prévu ?
 Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur. Vous devez toutefois être à l’aise de travailler en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs et de prendre en charge le niveau de détail nécessaire pour transformer une vision produit en produit fonctionnel.
 Pourquoi ce poste est-il important ? 
 Sadie évolue rapidement, et notre capacité à concrétiser notre vision produit dépend de notre aptitude à transformer les idées et les besoins des clients en travail clair et bien défini pour nos équipes d’ingénierie.
 Le Product Owner se situe entre la vision et l’exécution.
 Votre responsabilité est de faire en sorte que la roadmap ne demeure pas une simple collection d’idées. Elle devient des fonctionnalités clairement définies que l’ingénierie peut développer, que les clients peuvent utiliser et que l’entreprise peut mesurer.
 Qu’est-ce que j’apprendrai dans ce poste ? 
 Vous acquerrez une expérience pratique de la conception et de la mise à l’échelle d’un produit technologique en évolution rapide, utilisé chaque jour dans de véritables interactions avec les clients.
 Vous travaillerez étroitement avec la direction, l’ingénierie, les clients et les équipes commerciales, et développerez une compréhension approfondie de la façon dont la stratégie produit est traduite en exigences, livrée par l’ingénierie, validée auprès des clients et continuellement améliorée.

The Staff Product Manager is an Individual Contributor (IC) product leader responsible for a broad platform surface for Atlas Infinite at MongoDB. Atlas Infinite is the largest architectural innovation in MongoDB Atlas ever, purpose-built to handle today's speed and scale of development and demand. 
 In this position, you will own and solve end-to-end problems around the user experience and database experience of Atlas Infinite, including but limited to feature discovery, activation, monetization, and retention. You will see patterns, opportunities, and risks across areas, own cross-team product and architectural trade-offs, establish reusable standards for PM craft, and align senior stakeholders around multi-year bets. You have deep knowledge of cloud database platforms, distributed data systems, and enterprise product development.
 You will partner closely with cross-functional engineering leaders, product peers, and executive stakeholders to drive outcomes across organizational boundaries, guiding a portfolio spanning Atlas Infinite's disaggregated compute and storage architecture, production workload readiness, migration and Atlas interoperability, and the new customer experiences this architecture may make possible. You will not inherit a closed list of future features: part of your mandate is to discover opportunities we have not yet articulated and challenge assumptions about which problems matter most. With AWS public preview now live, you will help turn real workload evidence into a credible path to GA and subsequent releases, in close partnership with the existing team.
 This role can be based out of a MongoDB office or remotely in Canada.
 Responsibilities
 Interlinked Vision & Multi-Year Bets: Set and champion a product vision across Atlas Infinite's capabilities, while actively discovering opportunities that are not on today's roadmap or fit any single team's remit. Explore what decoupled compute and storage could make possible for developers, enterprises, and emerging AI workloads; use hypotheses, customer evidence, prototypes, and market signals to uncover needs we have not yet named. Branching, on-demand compute, and instant recovery are examples of possible bets. Make the case for investment and prioritization, including build-vs-buy considerations, and distinguish exploratory vision from release commitments
 Cross-Team Execution: Along with program management, own execution health across workstreams, negotiating sequencing, scope, and resource trade-offs with engineering leaders and peer PMs where you have no direct authority. Ensure preview-to-GA readiness, roadmaps, and dependencies across database, storage, Atlas platform, migration, backup, security, and cloud infrastructure teams are aligned and connect to company objectives
 Execution & Research Standards: Establish lightweight operating practices and shared customer/market research frameworks that make workload qualification, customer-representative testing, win/loss analysis, launch readiness, and post-launch learning consistent across the portfolio. Use data to drive decisions without overburdening delivery teams
 Product Health: Resolve complex post-launch escalations when the root cause spans architecture, performance, migration, observability, supportability, or unclear ownership. Turn customer and operational signals into systemic product fixes rather than one-off workarounds
 Customer Discovery: Identify needs and competitive dynamics that cut across product areas. Look beyond requests from today's customers to discover emerging jobs-to-be-done, surprising uses of the architecture, and reasons customers do not choose MongoDB at all. Combine interviews, workload and pricing evidence, product analytics, field feedback, and experiments to test known hypotheses and uncover unknowns; reorient the roadmap when the evidence warrants it
 Outbound & GTM: Partner with product marketing, pricing, sales, solutions architecture, customer success, documentation, and support on high-stakes customer engagements, product positioning, and omni-channel marketing. Establish ideal customer profile; ensure claims and migration guidance match demonstrated capabilities; translate successful adoption and enablement approaches into shared playbooks
 Executive Alignment: Synthesize customer experience, technical readiness, adoption, and commercial impact into clear, confident product stories for senior leadership. Surface cross-area risks and progress early, including trade-offs between new-workload growth, customer savings, and changes to existing Atlas usage
 Mentorship: Mentor PMs across the area, sharing frameworks for cross-team alignment, customer evidence, technical trade-offs, multi-year bets, and leadership communication
 Qualifications
 8+ years of product management or equivalent product leadership experience, with a track record personally shaping strategy and outcomes for complex technical platforms across multiple teams, rather than only coordinating delivery
 Strong technical fluency in cloud databases, distributed data systems, storage infrastructure, developer experiences, or an adjacent developer platform. Able to reason with engineers about architecture, performance, availability, data movement, and trade-offs without needing to be the system designer
 A demonstrated ability to discover opportunities beyond the current roadmap: connect technical possibilities to unmet customer needs, formulate and test hypotheses, notice surprising patterns, and change direction when evidence challenges the original thesis
 Experience taking a complex product from early adoption toward dependable, broader use while protecting space for longer-term innovation; able to make explicit trade-offs among customer trust, technical readiness, speed, and investment
 Proven ability to influence without authority, negotiating sequencing and resource trade-offs across partner teams with competing priorities
 Commercial and analytical judgment: able to assess workload-level value, adoption and usage evidence, competitive alternatives, pricing and unit economics, and the impact of a new product on an existing portfolio. Comfortable with build-vs-buy questions where relevant
 Ability to raise the quality of customer discovery and product decision-making across teams through useful shared methods and mentorship, without mistaking more process for better outcomes
 Exceptional communication skills: able to explain a technical and commercial thesis, its uncertainties, and the evidence that would change your mind to engineers, customers, executives, and go-to-market partners
 Success Measures
 In 3 months you will have built a shared picture of which workloads Atlas Infinite serves well today, where customers struggle, what must be true for broader adoption, and what remains unknown. You will have clarified ownership with peer PMs and engineering, established baseline measures, and identified the highest-value questions to investigate
 In 6 months you will have influenced consequential roadmap and GA-readiness decisions with customer-representative evidence; articulated a compelling, revisable view of where Infinite can create distinctive customer value beyond GA; and built a learning agenda with clear tests and decision points for both known bets and newly emerging opportunities
 In 12 months the portfolio will show measurable progress against its established baselines for qualified adoption, customer experience, and readiness for broader workloads. Important bets will have advanced, changed, or been stopped for explicit reasons; cross-team investments will have produced customer value; and the team will be better equipped to recognize and act on opportunities that were not visible at the start of the year

KittySpout / DoggySpout   is looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to join our team! As our creative strategist, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a heavy focus on Meta VSLs, UGC ads, and high-converting direct response ads - short and long form - that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in performance creative, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
Who are we? 
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space — $22M+ in revenue and targeting $45-50M in 2026. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
 Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow.
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.
Key Objectives: 
 Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
 Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
 Script Direct response creatives
 Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
 Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
 Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
 Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
 Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative
 Produce a minimum of 15 ad briefs per week , maintaining volume and quality simultaneously — without being chased.
 Fully remote
 Fluent in English
 Direct Response Expertise: 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
 Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience interpreting performance data from platforms such as Northbeam, Facebook Ads, leveraging spreadsheets and reporting tools to extract insights, inform strategy and communicate campaign ideas and results.
 No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
 Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
 Proven VSL copywriting experience on DR / performance brands
 Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories.
 Meta VSLs: Proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run.
 AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production — not one you tried once.
 Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
 Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands
Examples of What You'll Be Doing: 
 Develop VSL briefings end-to-end: angle, hook, script, structure
 Design AI-driven concepts and hooks for paid video
 Partner with editors and performance marketers on testing
 Iterate strategy based on creative performance data
How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate: 
 We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates in our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has three stages:
(1) Application Review + Screening - we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit. 
(2) Technical Interview + Creative Brief - a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work. 
(3) Culture Fit Interview - a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us. 
KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
 Salary Expectation 
 USD $3,000 - $6,000 per month base (based on experience and expertise) + percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
 We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta only.

 À propos de l’entreprise 
 Vous voulez travailler dans une équipe fière de soigner les animaux et de sauver des vies ? Le Groupe DMV regroupe deux grandes familles : CENTREDMVET, notre centre de référence et d'urgence, et Passionimo, notre grand réseau de cliniques vétérinaires. Que vous aimiez le rythme effréné de l'urgence ou les liens durables de la médecine générale, vous trouverez votre place parmi nos passionnés. Nos amis poilus n'ont jamais eu autant besoin de votre aide ! 
 Votre rôle dans l’équipe 
 Selon ce qui vous ressemble, vous pouvez vous joindre à l'une de nos deux équipes. Vous serez le bras droit des médecins vétérinaires et un.e professionnel.le de la santé animale à part entière. 
 Votre quotidien (Option 1 : CENTREDMVET - Urgence et spécialités) : 
 Évaluer les patients et attribuer les priorités selon le degré d'urgence lors du triage. 
 Transmettre l'horaire des médicaments et les recommandations pour la maison une fois le départ autorisé. 
 Effectuer diverses tâches connexes pour soutenir l'équipe médicale spécialisée. 
 Votre quotidien (Option 2 : Cliniques Passionimo - Médecine générale) : 
 Participer activement aux soins des patients en collaboration avec le ou la vétérinaire. 
 Établir une relation de confiance avec la clientèle et lui offrir une expérience exceptionnelle. 
 Conseiller et rassurer les clients sur l'état de santé de leur compagnon. 
 Veiller au confort et au bien-être des animaux traités. 
 Profil recherché 
 Diplôme de technicien ou technicienne en santé animale (La mention « Certifié » est un bel atout !). 
 Expérience pertinente dans un poste semblable. 
 Sens de l'observation aiguisé, bonne organisation et débrouillardise. 
 Service à la clientèle hors pair et communication claire. 
 Énergie positive : vous êtes la personne d'équipe sur qui vos collègues peuvent compter en tout temps. 
 Une véritable passion pour les animaux et une grande importance accordée à la qualité des services et à la santé/sécurité. 
 Pourquoi nous choisir ? (Ce qu’on vous offre) : 
 Flexibilité d'horaire : De 32 à 40 heures par semaine. Choix de quarts de jour, soir ou nuit avec 1 fin de semaine sur 2 (pour l'urgence), ou quarts de jour/soir et samedis au besoin (pour la clinique). 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire compétitif avec primes de quart pour l'équipe d'urgence, et un régime de retraite avec participation de l'employeur (CENTREDMVET). 
 Santé et bien-être : Régime complet d'assurances collectives, accès à la télémédecine et programme d'aide aux employés (PAE). 
 Avantages poilus : Généreux rabais sur nos soins animaliers et sur la nourriture pour vos propres animaux. 
 Nous avons hâte d’échanger avec toi ! Si vous voulez faire partie d'une équipe passionnée et motivée, c'est le moment de postuler : dpedro@humanify360.com (Indiquez si vous visez CENTREDMVET, Passionimo, ou si les deux vous intéressent !). 
 Vous avez des questions avant de postuler ? 
 En personne (Journées carrières) : Venez prendre un café avec vos questions en tête, visiter nos installations et sentir l'énergie de l'équipe à Lachine (14 novembre) ou Blainville (21 novembre).

The Solutions Architect designs the end-to-end architecture required to deploy and operate our solutions successfully in each client’s production environment. This includes infrastructure, cloud and hybrid platforms, integrations, systems, networks, databases, security, observability, and site reliability engineering (SRE).
 The role spans the full client lifecycle. During the bid and pre-sales stages, the Solutions Architect defines the target architecture and technical requirements, evaluates total cost of ownership (TCO), and partners with Sales to develop the Statement of Work (SOW). During implementation and operation, they guide technical delivery and remain accountable for the solution’s availability, performance, scalability, and reliability.
 This is a hands-on position for someone who is equally comfortable making high-impact architecture decisions and investigating traces, query plans, or network traffic during a production incident. As the technical authority and ultimate escalation point for solution architecture, this person works closely with clients, Support, Monitoring, DevOps, SRE, Product Architecture, and R&D. The position reports to the Customer Delivery & Performance Engineering group.
 The people who thrive here are relentless in solving problems others have not cracked. They follow the evidence wherever it leads, make sound decisions despite uncertainty, and favour delivering practical, measurable improvements over waiting for a perfect solution that arrives too late. They believe real-world feedback is one of the fastest ways to improve quality.
 Bilingualism in French and English is mandatory , as the position involves working with technical documentation and communicating with French- and English-speaking clients, partners, and colleagues.
 What you will do 
 Design the client-specific production architecture across infrastructure, cloud and hybrid platforms, systems, networks, integrations, databases, security, and observability.
 Size and optimize environments for availability, performance, scalability, resilience, and cost, using Infrastructure as Code and automation wherever appropriate.
 Support bids and pre-sales engagements by defining technical requirements, developing the target architecture, evaluating TCO, and partnering with Sales on the SOW.
 Make consequential architecture decisions under incomplete information or time pressure; document the rationale and revisit decisions when new evidence emerges.
 Resolve the most complex production issues by reproducing failures, identifying root causes, and implementing durable improvements to performance and reliability.
 Lead the technical response to high-severity incidents, from diagnosis and mitigation through verified resolution and follow-up corrective actions.
 Build prototypes, load tests, failure reproductions, and diagnostic tools to validate assumptions and settle technical questions with evidence.
 Define integrations and APIs with Product Architecture and client teams, ensuring interoperability, resilience, security, and compatibility with existing environments.
 Design and optimize database architecture, including performance, integrity, capacity planning, and secure schema migrations.
 Establish SRE, high-availability, and disaster-recovery practices, including SLOs, SLAs, recovery objectives, and measures to reduce mean time to recovery.
 Strengthen application observability through logs, metrics, traces, alerts, and dashboards developed with Monitoring, DevOps, SRE, and R&D.
 Design and automate CI/CD pipelines and deployment tooling to enable secure, repeatable, and reliable production releases.
 Monitor production health through reliability and performance indicators, and assess delivery effectiveness using DORA metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, and time to restore service.
 Translate production findings into prioritized technical requirements for R&D, improving the product’s performance, reliability, observability, and deployability.
 Embed security, privacy, and regulatory compliance into every architecture decision, particularly where health data is involved.
 Establish client architecture standards, guide deployment, DevOps, and SRE specialists, mentor technical colleagues, and influence cross-functional decisions without relying on formal authority.
 Artificial intelligence 
 Partner with the AI Lab to define and promote the responsible integration of AI and generative AI—including LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, and orchestrated workflows—into client solutions and their supporting architecture.
 Design AI-enabled operational capabilities such as anomaly detection, performance analysis, and intelligent automation, with appropriate security, privacy, governance, and human oversight.
 Help technical teams use AI responsibly and effectively, critically assess AI-generated outputs, monitor emerging developments, and advise leadership on relevant opportunities and risks.
What you bring 
 A university degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
 At least 10 years of experience in solution, systems, or infrastructure architecture within production environments, ideally in a multi-client or managed-services setting.
 Demonstrated expertise in cloud and hybrid architecture, Infrastructure as Code, networking, and client-specific infrastructure design.
 Strong knowledge of SRE, high availability, disaster recovery, observability, performance engineering, and incident management.
 A track record of personally diagnosing and resolving complex production failures, including the ability to explain how the root cause was identified and what actions were taken during the critical first hour.
 Fluency with diagnostic tools and techniques such as profilers, distributed tracing, packet capture, query plans, load testing, and operating-system-level investigation.
 A bias for action, supported by examples of delivering effective fixes, workarounds, or technical decisions in ambiguous and time-sensitive situations.
 Strong knowledge of systems integration, APIs, data architecture, database performance, migrations, and capacity planning.
 Experience designing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and Infrastructure as Code, as well as applying DORA metrics to improve software delivery.
 Experience incorporating security, privacy, and compliance requirements into architecture, ideally in healthcare or another regulated industry.
 Sound commercial judgment and the ability to balance technical performance, reliability, delivery speed, risk, and TCO.
 Experience integrating AI or generative AI responsibly into solutions or operational processes is a strong asset.
 Influential technical leadership, strong mentoring abilities, intellectual curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning.
 Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical situations clearly and concisely to clients, executives, Sales, and other non-technical audiences—particularly during live incidents.

When it comes to telling the world about Jobber and moving new people through a funnel, Marketing is your department. They handle everything from spreading awareness, to answering “What’s Jobber?,” to getting new customers in the door, to turning those customers into Jobber advocates!

Lifecycle marketing is responsible for creating and advocating for best-in-class experiences that deliver the right message, to the right people, at the right time. We leverage automation and data to build highly personalized end-to-end experiences our customers want, need, and like.

The Role:

Reporting to the Acquisition Manager,  Lifecycle Marketing, the Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager will be responsible for orchestrating our ideal customer experience. You will own and drive strategies for how we acquire, activate, retain, and expand users on all platforms. You will be accountable for enhancing our Lead Nurture efforts and creating experiences that are mutually beneficial to both customers and Jobber, ultimately ensuring we’re effectively capturing revenue.

You will partner cross-functionally to optimize our customer journey, including all associated customer communications. In addition, you will run experiments to explore and validate new strategies for how we can effectively move our customers through the funnel. You will represent Lifecycle Marketing across the organization and be a steward for your area of focus across the business.

Through your work with our Business Operations, Marketing, Sales, Success, Product, and Growth teams, you'll create great user experiences at scale and conduct experiments to discover what works.

The Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager will:

 - Own the Leads portfolio end to end: the strategy, the programs, and the metrics for how leads are nurtured into trials and how trials convert into paying customers.

 - Own and extend Jobber’s AI-enriched lead journeys, using enrichment and orchestration tooling (currently Clay and n8n) to build customer profiles and route leads into personalized experiences based on intent.

 - Connect the lead experience to the trial experience so a customer sees one continuous, personalized journey from first touch through conversion, and work with Product on how that personalization carries into the app.

 - Run a test-and-learn program against lead-to-trial and trial-to-paid metrics: form hypotheses, design experiments, read the results honestly, and iterate until the number moves.

 - Decide where the portfolio’s time goes. Diagnose where leads and trials are being lost, size the opportunities, and make the case for what comes first and what waits.

 - Lead the acquisition pod that connects lifecycle with our outbound and demand generation partners, owning the plan and the handoffs between teams and keeping leadership informed.

 - Build what you design. Depending on capacity, you’ll configure journeys, write emails, and set up automation yourself alongside our Revenue Communications team.

 - Set the bar for the Lifecycle team: bring outside insight in, share what you learn, and raise how the practice works at Jobber.

 - Have deep experience owning lead nurture and trial-to-paid conversion programs at a SaaS company, with results you can point to. B2B SaaS is the closest fit.

 - Have hands-on experience using AI tools to enrich customer data and personalize communications at scale, beyond drafting copy. You’ve built or configured enrichment, orchestration, or journey logic yourself and can say what it changed in your results.

 - Bring a test-and-learn posture to AI: you experiment with new tooling in your own workflow, can separate what works from what’s hype, and are comfortable in the weeds when the data is incomplete.

 - Have led integrated acquisition efforts across outbound, demand generation, product, and sales, owning the plan and the handoffs rather than executing the lifecycle piece of someone else’s.

 - Know the metrics behind nurture and conversion cold, and have moved them through experimentation and program iteration, not just reported on them.

 - Take full ownership of the outcomes tied to your KPIs, including when the data is imperfect. You find a way to measure, ship, and learn rather than wait for clean inputs.

 - Understand customer behaviour, barriers, and motivations from first-hand sources, and change the journey because of what you learn.

 - Operate with a high degree of autonomy. You set your own priorities, keep your manager informed without being asked, and flag risk early.

 - Push for better ways of doing things, and stay humble while you do it.

 Au cours de vos 90 premiers jours de travail…

About Citylitics Inc. 
 Who Are We Looking For? 
 We're looking for a skilled and enthusiastic Data Engineer to join our growing team! We're a close-knit group building and maintaining mission-critical data products, and we need someone who can hit the ground running.
 This role requires a strong command of data engineering best practices, a track record with orchestration and data warehouses, and hands-on experience shipping LLM and agentic workflows to production. You'll own the design, build, and operation of production data pipelines that use AI to power customer-facing solutions. You'll work with technologies we already use, including GCP services like Cloud Composer, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, and Vertex AI.
 Beyond the technical skills, we value collaboration, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to adapt as AI tooling changes fast. If you're passionate about data, have put AI into production and want to do more of it, and are excited by impactful projects, we encourage you to apply.
 This is a hybrid role based out of Citylitics’ Toronto office and requires 3+ days in-office per week. 
 What Will You Accomplish? / How You Will Make An Immediate Impact: 
 Pipeline Orchestration: Lead the development of highly performant, reliable, and maintainable pipelines using Airflow and BigQuery, from architecture and design through testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. You'll make design decisions independently and own the systems you build.
 Data Modeling & Dashboards: Partner with data analysts and stakeholders to define requirements and design scalable data models and applications. You'll own data products end to end, from the pipelines and models through the backend APIs to the customer-facing dashboards and apps built on them.
 AI & Agentic Workflows: Design and operate pipelines that use LLMs and agents to turn raw documents into structured, useful data. This includes prompt and context design, tool and function calling, embeddings and retrieval, structured outputs, and production concerns like retries, idempotency, cost, and latency. You'll also own evaluation datasets, LLM-as-judge and rule-based QA checks, and benchmarks that turn results into clear decisions about models, prompts, and architecture.
 Continuous Improvement: Drive the ongoing improvement of our data infrastructure and processes, including evaluating and introducing new technologies and best practices. We're an AI-first team that uses coding agents like Claude Code daily for development, debugging, review, and documentation, and we're looking for someone who can help shape how we push that further.
 Other duties as assigned 
 Proficiency in Python and SQL.
 Proven experience (3+ years) working as a Data Engineer or Software Engineer in a cloud environment.
 Experience building production data pipelines with an orchestrator like Airflow/Cloud Composer and a data warehouse like BigQuery.
 Solid grasp of data engineering fundamentals: data modeling, ETL/ELT, and building idempotent, reliable pipelines.
 Experience shipping LLM-powered features or pipelines to production with LLM APIs (e.g., Gemini, Claude, OpenAI): prompting, structured outputs, and tool/function calling.
 Working knowledge of agent patterns (tool use, multi-step workflows, retrieval/RAG, MCP) and their production tradeoffs, such as cost, latency, and failure modes.
 Daily, fluent use of AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) in your workflow, with the judgment to review and verify what they produce.
 Experience with Git, CI/CD, and cloud platforms (GCP preferred).
 Experience building data apps or dashboards end to end, including a backend API and a frontend (e.g., React, TypeScript), is a plus.
 Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently on ambiguous problems.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills. You'll be working closely with analysts, product, and other stakeholders.
 Vacancy Status: This position is for an existing and active vacancy that the company is currently seeking to fill.
 What’s in it for you? 
 Make real-world impact: Influence positive change across one of the biggest societal challenges of our generation: building and maintaining sustainable public infrastructure.
 Sell a genuinely differentiated platform: You’ll represent a disruptive, data-driven solution with a compelling value proposition in a market that is eager to engage.
 Operate at the intersection of infrastructure, scale-up, and data science: We live where infrastructure meets AI and advanced data. There is no other team like ours in Toronto.
 Move fast, learn faster: There’s no corporate bureaucracy here. You’ll accomplish more in a few months than you would in years at a large, entrenched technology company.
 Be empowered by data and AI: We believe Data and AI will play an outsized role in the future of sales and decision-making. Every CityZen has access to generative AI tools and our full data universe to enhance productivity and encourage experimentation.
 Grow with intention: We invest deeply in our people through in-role coaching, skill-based development, and clear internal promotion pathways.
 Win as a team: We work hard, we support one another, and we celebrate progress along the way. We’re serious about solving infrastructure and just as serious about enjoying the journey together.

 THE ROLE
 This is a full sales cycle seat, not a closer-only seat.
 Qualified leads come to you. Demand is inbound heavy, generated through our own paid marketing across Amazon, Meta and Google, so warm leads land on your calendar — you don't have to find it. But if your calendar is light, you do not sit and wait. You work the list, you set your own calls, and you get the deal on the books.  Who you'll be selling to: e-commerce entrepreneurs whose businesses range from a couple million a year to a couple million a month. You need to be able to hold a sales conversation with them as a peer — without pedestalizing them.
 YOUR NUMBER
 Cash collected is the #1 KPI. Not calls booked, not proposals sent, not pipeline created — cash collected. Close rate, average deal size, speed to close, and pipeline hygiene all support that one number.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO
 • Run the full cycle on inbound and referred demand — first call to signature to payment.
 • Set your own calls when the calendar has room. Follow up relentlessly on no-shows, stalls, and old leads.
 • Diagnose a prospect's e-commerce business live on the call and connect it to what we do.
 • Build and present proposals for monthly retainers, handle objections, and get signatures.
 • Own collection — a signed deal that doesn't pay is not a closed deal.
 • Keep the CRM clean and current: every deal, every next step, every dollar.
 • Work with the delivery team so what you sell is what gets delivered.
 WHO THIS IS NOT FOR
 • You only work leads that are already on your calendar.
 • You need a manager to tell you what to do each morning.

 • Your experience is one-call, one-time-payment consumer sales with no retainer track record.

 Steady state, after ramp:
 • $30,000+ in new MRR cash collected per month, minimum.
 • 6–8 closed retainers per month, at a $4,000–$5,000/month average deal size.
 • 100% of signed deals paid — a signed deal that doesn't pay is not a closed deal.
 • 25%+ live call close rate (calls held to signed).
 • Speed to close: first call to signature within 14 days on qualified deals.
 • Average deal size held at or above $4,000/month.
 • Supported by 4–5 qualified calls a day, 5 days a week (about 100 held calls a month), with enough open calendar space to absorb full inbound demand and self-set calls when the calendar is light.
 TIME & LOCATION
 • Full time, 30–40 hours a week, with freedom to build your own schedule — as long as there's enough open calendar space to hold 4–5 calls a day.

 WHAT YOU NEED
 This is a senior, high-trust seat, and we are being deliberately selective.

 • Full sales cycle experience — you have set your own meetings, not just taken handed-off calls.

 • B2B agency sales experience.
 • Based in the US, Canada, or UK, working US business hours.
 • A self-starter. That includes proactively studying — advertising, e-commerce, and B2B sales, daily.
 • Detailed and punctual. Our system is operations heavy: a clean and updated CRM, Slack, end-of-day reports, and the rest of the process are non-negotiable.
 • Comfortable being measured in public: cash collected, close rate, and pipeline hygiene are all visible.
 WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT
 • You've sold for an Amazon, Meta, Google, or TikTok performance agency.
 • You can read an ad account or P&L and speak to it live on a call.
 • You've carried a quota where the deal was a monthly commitment, not a one-time payment.

À propos de MaintainX

MaintainX est une plateforme d’exécution du travail de premier plan, conçue d’abord pour le mobile, à l’intention des équipes industrielles et de première ligne. Plus de 13 000 clients, dont Duracell, McDonald’s, Shell, DHL et Volvo, utilisent MaintainX pour réduire les arrêts imprévus et mieux gérer leurs opérations. La plateforme compte plus de 13,9 millions d’actifs gérés et 79,5 millions d’ordres de travail complétés, et nous bâtissons le plus vaste ensemble de données opérationnelles réelles de la catégorie.

En août 2026, MaintainX est devenue partie intégrante d’Autodesk et a rejoint Autodesk Operations Solutions https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/views/inside-autodesk-operations-solutions/, l’organisation qui unifie la plateforme d’exploitation d’Autodesk aux côtés de Tandem, FlexSim et Fusion Operations. La stratégie d’Autodesk consiste à réunir la conception, la fabrication et l’exploitation en un seul cycle de vie continu : concevoir un actif, le construire, l’exploiter, puis réinjecter ce que l’on apprend en l’exploitant dans la conception suivante. Autodesk avait la conception et la fabrication. L’exploitation est la phase qui révèle ce qui s’est réellement passé, et c’est la nôtre.

Le poste

Ce poste se situe au sein de l’équipe Marketing événementiel. Vous contribuerez à bâtir et à mener le programme d’événements terrain de MaintainX, qui comprend des événements régionaux, des rencontres d’utilisateurs, des activations de marque et notre conférence phare destinée à la clientèle, avec une personne mentore dans l’équipe pour vous aider à prendre en charge des volets de plus en plus importants.

Vous participerez à chaque volet du programme, de la rencontre régionale près de chez vous jusqu’à la conférence phare qui réunit nos plus grands clients, et vous prendrez rapidement de réelles responsabilités.

 - Planifier et réaliser des événements régionaux, des rencontres d’utilisateurs et des activations de marque afin de placer MaintainX devant les prospects et les clients qui comptent le plus.

 - Constituer les listes de participants, coordonner les invitations et assurer le suivi afin de transformer les conversations tenues lors des événements en véritable pipeline.

 - Prendre en charge de bout en bout les événements de moindre envergure (lieu, fournisseurs, déroulé, tout y est) et participer à la préparation de la conférence phare.

 - Suivre ce qui fonctionne, comme les rencontres obtenues, les comptes engagés et le pipeline généré et influencé, afin d’améliorer chaque événement par rapport au précédent.

 - Collaborer avec les équipes de design, de contenu et de génération de la demande afin de donner vie aux événements : pages d’atterrissage, affichage, articles promotionnels, expérience complète sur place.

 - Profiter d’une place de choix pour la conférence phare de MaintainX, avec la possibilité de passer de la logistique à la programmation.

D’ici 6 à 12 mois, vous mènerez seul des événements de moindre envergure et jouerez un rôle réel dans la réussite de la conférence phare.

Votre profil

Requis

 - 1 à 2 ans et plus d’expérience en marketing terrain, en marketing événementiel ou dans un rôle connexe d’événements en présentiel, idéalement dans le SaaS B2B

 - Expérience de la réalisation d’événements en présentiel, de petits soupers à des rassemblements régionaux

 - Solides compétences en gestion de projet et souci du détail; aisance à mener plusieurs programmes de front

 - Excellent esprit de collaboration : vous savez travailler avec les ventes, les fournisseurs et les parties prenantes internes pour faire avancer les choses

 - Esprit créatif et réel enthousiasme pour les expériences mémorables, centrées sur l’humain

 - Passeport valide et capacité de voyager environ 15 % du temps aux États-Unis et au Canada

Atouts

 - Expérience avec la GMAO, les logiciels industriels ou un autre environnement de démarrage ou entrepreneurial

 - Aisance avec les outils d’IA pour le travail quotidien en marketing (un atout, pas une exigence)

Ce que nous offrons

 - Un travail qui se voit dans le monde réel. Ce que vous aidez à lancer et à promouvoir fait tourner des usines, des flottes et des installations. Quand ça fonctionne, une ligne de production ne s’arrête pas et un technicien termine sa journée à l’heure.

 - Du mentorat intégré. Vous apprendrez à mener un événement client phare auprès de quelqu’un qui en dirige déjà un, et vous y arriverez plus vite.

 - L’envergure d’Autodesk, la même mission. Une portée mondiale et les moyens d’une entreprise cotée en bourse et rentable, dirigés vers le problème que nous attaquions déjà.

 - Une carrière avec de la place pour grandir. Le marketing terrain et événementiel est encore en construction chez nous, avec un parcours clair : soutenir le programme, puis en assumer des volets à part entière.

Notre façon de travailler

Nous récompensons les résultats, pas les heures travaillées ni les chapeaux portés. Vous obtiendrez une réelle autonomie à mesure que vous grandirez dans le rôle, et une personne mentore investie dans votre réussite. Nous avançons vite, avons des conversations franches tôt, et nous attendons la même chose en retour.

MaintainX s’engage à créer un environnement de travail inclusif. Toutes les candidatures qualifiées seront considérées sans égard à la race, la couleur, la religion, le genre, l’identité ou l’expression de genre, l’orientation sexuelle, l’origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l’âge ou le statut d’ancien combattant.
